## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` pass
- [ ] New logic has tests, and logic lives in `src/lib`, not in components
- [ ] The token is never logged, put in a URL, or stored in the browser
- [ ] Docs and the README are updated if behavior changed (scoring changes go in `docs/how-scoring-works.md`)
